citations.quote: Bel'Veth gains permanent attack speed stacks after taking down large minions and monsters and champions.

core_mechanics.summary: Permanent attack speed growth supports sustained fighting.

citations.quote: Bel'Veth's basic attacks deal bonus true damage and generates a stack that increases this damage against the same target.

core_mechanics.summary: Repeated attacks increase her true damage against the same target.

title: Bel'Veth

citations.quote: Death in Lavender's takedown effect will not trigger against monsters if they were slain by an enemy.

advanced_exceptions.summary: Enemy-slain monsters do not trigger the takedown effect.

citations.quote: Bel'Veth gains permanent attack speed stacks after taking down large minions and monsters and champions.

core_mechanics.summary: Relevant takedowns grant permanent attack speed stacks.

citations.quote: After casting an ability, Bel'Veth becomes ghosted and gains bonus attack speed for a few seconds.

core_mechanics.summary: Ability casts grant ghosting and temporary attack speed.

purpose: Recognize attack speed growth and post-cast pressure.
title: Death in Lavender

citations.quote: Void Surge's damage against the first enemy hit can critically strike and applies on-hit effects and life steal.
Void Surge resets Bel'Veth's basic attack timer.

advanced_exceptions.summary: The first target receives critical strike, on-hit, and life steal interactions; the dash also resets her attack timer.

citations.quote: Bel'Veth dashes in the target direction, though not through terrain, dealing physical damage to enemies she passes through.

core_mechanics.summary: A directional dash deals physical damage along its path.

citations.quote: each direction has a unique cooldown that scales down with her bonus attack speed.

core_mechanics.summary: Dash directions recover independently and faster with bonus attack speed.

citations.quote: During this time, Void Surge can dash through terrain.

purpose: Recognize directional dash limits and True Form mobility.
title: Void Surge

citations.quote: More than one cooldown can be reset if enemy champions were hit within multiple directions.
The cooldowns that get reset are based on the relative direction to Bel'Veth at the end of the cast

advanced_exceptions.summary: Champion hits across multiple relative directions can reset multiple dash cooldowns.

citations.quote: Bel'Veth slams her tail in the target direction that deals magic damage to enemies hit, briefly knocking up and slowing them.

core_mechanics.summary: Directional magic damage knocks up and slows.

citations.quote: If this hits an enemy champion, it resets Void Surge's dash cooldown of the target direction.

core_mechanics.summary: Champion hits refresh directional dash availability.

purpose: Recognize the crowd control that also restores mobility.
title: Above and Below

citations.quote: The target does not have to be visible to be hit by this ability.

advanced_exceptions.summary: Targets can be hit without being visible.

citations.quote: Royal Maelstrom can be recast within the duration, and does so automatically afterwards or when Bel'Veth casts an ability. Recast: Bel'Veth ends Royal Maelstrom.

advanced_exceptions.summary: She can end the stance early, including by casting another ability.

citations.quote: during which she is unable to move, but gains damage reduction and life steal.

core_mechanics.summary: She becomes stationary with damage reduction and life steal.

citations.quote: she rapidly slashes at the nearest enemy with the lowest current health percentage
Royal Maelstrom does not prioritize champions over other units.

core_mechanics.summary: Slashes select by low current health percentage without champion priority.

citations.quote: Each slash deals physical damage, increased by 0% – 100% (based on target's missing health)
Bel'Veth cannot perform slashes while she is affected by cast-inhibiting crowd control.

core_mechanics.summary: Slashes punish missing health and are suppressed by cast-inhibiting crowd control.

purpose: Recognize the defensive slash stance and its target selection.
title: Royal Maelstrom

citations.quote: Bel'Veth consumes all existing Void Corals at once
A nearby Void Coral is required to cast this ability.

advanced_exceptions.summary: Casting requires nearby coral, but consumption also collects all existing coral.

citations.quote: Bel'Veth's True Form at 80 Lavender stacks will last indefinitely, but is still lost upon death.

advanced_exceptions.summary: Sufficient Lavender makes True Form last until death.

citations.quote: Bel'Veth's basic attacks deal bonus true damage and generates a stack that increases this damage against the same target.

core_mechanics.summary: Repeated attacks increase bonus true damage against the same target.

citations.quote: Takedowns against enemy champions and epic monsters spawn a Void Coral for some time.
Bel'Veth dashes to the target Void Coral, gradually slowing nearby enemies before violently exploding, dealing true damage based on their missing health

core_mechanics.summary: Coral consumption slows nearby enemies before a missing-health true damage explosion.

citations.quote: True Form: Bel'Veth gains bonus health, attack range, and increased total attack speed.
Consuming more Void Corals renews the form's duration and heals her instead.

core_mechanics.summary: True Form grants combat stats; further consumption refreshes it and heals her.

citations.quote: Taking down Baron Nashor, the pit Rift Herald, or a Voidgrub spawns an Enhance Void Coral.
True Form is empowered to cause Void Remora to spawn from minions that die nearby.

core_mechanics.summary: Enhanced coral enables nearby dying minions to spawn Void Remora.

purpose: Recognize coral danger and the normal and enhanced True Form rewards together.
title: Endless Banquet
